text:
incident-bot: PAGER/ALERT: model-catalog-service - high error rate detected for model routing (auto-page)
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident triggered -> paging Ashley (oncall)
Ashley: acked. I'm on it. seeing the PD alert now.
Tom: any quick signal on impact? 5xx or latency?
Ashley: 5xx spikes on /v1/generate for model rwd-13b-std. error rate +150% over last 3m. tail latency normal.
Jas: FYI I just promoted a catalog revision a few mins ago as part of the scheduled rollout (rev: rev-2026-03-09-rc7). Rolling in a defaults change; checking now.
Ashley: can you paste the catalog entry? suspect bad tokenizer/defaults based on past incidents.
Jas: here's the model entry that went live. looks like `tokenizer: byte` accidentally slipped in from a testing branch instead of `tokenizer: bpe`.
```
models:
  - id: rwd-13b-std
    revision: rev-2026-03-09-rc7
    default_variant: v1
    specs:
      tokenizer: byte       # <-- wrong, should be bpe
      max_seq: 4096
      replicas: 4
      kv_cache: enabled
```
Ashley: yup that would explain decoding errors for some clients -> garbage outputs -> client-side validation failing -> 5xx. immediate mitigation options: 1) route traffic to fallback variant (v0) 2) pin to previous revision 3) revert catalog entry and re-promote. prefer quickest: route to fallback then revert.
Lena: I can flip routing. Use Console API to update route targets. command below to promote fallback variant in prod routing:
```
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/routes/rwd-13b-std/override" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"target_variant":"v0","reason":"emergency fallback - bad tokenizer in rev-2026-03-09-rc7"}'
```
Lena: doing the change now.
deploy-bot: route-override started: task_id=task_5f7c. rolling to 100% fallback variant within 30s.
Ashley: thanks. Jas, can you prepare a rollback or catalog patch that reverts tokenizer to `bpe` and pin revision after we confirm steady state?
Jas: on it. I'll open a PR to model-catalog repo to change tokenizer and also create an emergency revert promotion to stable rev: rev-2026-02-28-stable.
deploy-bot: route-override succeeded: task_id=task_5f7c -> 100% traffic to v0 (fallback). health check: OK, 200 responses resuming. time=1959123540
Tom: monitoring: 5xx rate back to baseline within ~40s of override. good.
Ashley: customer impact snapshot: overall requests affected ~0.7% of global traffic but two enterprise customers (AcmeHealth, FinLedger) experienced degraded outputs - their request share to this model is 8% and 12% respectively. CS already notified.
Carlos: I've reached out to AcmeHealth & FinLedger support contacts, told them we routed to fallback and are doing a full rollback + postmortem. they'll escalate if they see differences. I put a short mitigation note into CS tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4567
Tom: Jas, once PR is ready, can you run a dry-run promotion to staging before re-promote to prod? want to avoid repeated flip-flops.
Jas: yes. PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/model-catalog/pull/1982 - patch changes tokenizer -> bpe and pins revision. I'll run promotion to staging and run quick tokenization test harness.
Ashley: do we want to mark incident sev? feels like P2 since fallback prevented broad customer outages but two customers are affected.
Lena: agree P2. I'll open incident document and severity tags.
Lena: creating incident ticket now: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-0331-12 (placeholder)
Ashley: is there an automated alert that fired when tokenizer mismatch occurs? we should add a validation check to CI to catch tokenizer drift.
Tom: noted. I'll add a task to eng-runtime: add schema validation that rejects unknown tokenizers on catalog promotion. tagging as follow-up.
deploy-bot: rollback promotion to rev-2026-02-28-stable started by Jas. task_id=task_5f80. ETA ~2m.
deploy-bot: rollback completed. rev=rev-2026-02-28-stable promoted to prod. health checks passing. time=1959123785
Tom: after rollback: 5xx back to baseline and QA tokenization tests passed in staging + prod smoke.
Ashley: OK good. Carlos keep CS looped. Jas follow-up: PR merge + postmortem notes of how tokenizer changed slipped. assign owners for CI validation. Lena to own incident doc and severity timeline.
Carlos: pinged both accounts that we rolled back and will follow-up with detailed postmortem.
Ashley: handing off to Tom for console follow-ups and CI fixes. summary: root cause = wrong tokenizer field in catalog promotion (rev-2026-03-09-rc7). mitigation = emergency route override to fallback then rollback to stable. customer impact limited but actionable. next actions: merge PR, add CI validation, update runbook.
Tom: taking handoff. I'll create follow-up tickets and drive CI validation. if anyone sees regressions ping me. I'll be on duty for next 4hrs.
Ashley: thanks team. closing paging loop. :white_check_mark:
